channel.title: Star Wars FFG — Campaign Deep-Match V2 (Shard Moon & Moraband)
channel.description: A focused research-led campaign-inspiration feed: evidence-audited and synopsis-qualified publisher-hosted science-fiction stories, actual plays and Star Wars lore for a research facility mystery and an ancient Force-world expedition. Non-Star-Wars material is explicitly inspirational only. Source URLs are not mirrored. This is an independent edition; the original Star Wars feed remains unchanged.
channel.itunes:author: Independent Quarky listening catalog (unaffiliated with publishers)
channel.itunes:summary: Evidence-tiered Shard Moon and Moraband campaign listening. The old subscribed feed is preserved.

item.title: 01 · SHARD MOON · 3d6 Down The Line — Mothership: Gradient Descent Ep 01 - Sci-Fi Horror RPG | Thalassophobia
item.description: Why selected: Timed public transcript samples include the AI taking control of an android factory, complex interactions with surviving occupants, and a crew entering the installation; a very close scenario-level analogue. Listening focus: Facility AI, manufactured people and expedition negotiations. Evidence: partial transcript. This audio remains at its original publisher. Non-Star-Wars recordings are outside-fiction GM inspiration, not campaign or Star Wars canon.

item.title: 02 · SHARD MOON · Among the Stars and Bones — S1E1 - "The Key to Humanity's Future"
item.description: Why selected: The Herodotus team discovers an alien city, a terraformer, skeletons and an unknown box. Listen for scientific specialization, contested interpretations and progressive evidence, not horror spectacle. Listening focus: Archaeological field teams and evidence of vanished inhabitants. Evidence: publisher synopsis. This audio remains at its original publisher. Non-Star-Wars recordings are outside-fiction GM inspiration, not campaign or Star Wars canon.

item.title: 12 · MORABAND · A More Civilized Age — 78: Korriban (Knights of the Old Republic 09)
item.description: Why selected: A direct Moraband/Korriban setting analogue: Sith Academy students, competing beliefs, tomb exploration and old power structures. Listening focus: how ordinary students interpret Sith training and how ruins communicate past history. This is Knights of the Old Republic game-analysis commentary, not an FFG actual play or canonical campaign event. Evidence: publisher episode synopsis; no full transcript read. Original publication: Wed, 24 Jan 2024 07:15:57 +0000. Hosted by original publisher.
